brand.name: KALKI TECHNOLOGIES
brand.mission: To democratize access to cutting‑edge AI by building a distributed, private, and ultra‑fast inference network.
brand.vision: A world where AI is open, private, and accessible to everyone – powered by the collective compute of millions of devices.

ki_bot.name: KI Bot
ki_bot.description: The fastest AI chatbot powered by KALKI 6.0 inference engine. Uses parallel multi‑model ensemble (Groq, Zhipu, Cerebras, WebLLM) to deliver the best answer.

ki_cloud.name: KI Cloud
ki_cloud.description: Community hub with marketplace, social feed, and developer resources.

faqs.question: What is KALKI AI?
faqs.answer: KALKI AI is a next‑generation AI platform that combines distributed inference, private AI (WebLLM), and a suite of digital marketing services. It’s the Temple of Technology.

faqs.question: How does the parallel ensemble work?
faqs.answer: We send your prompt to Groq, Zhipu, Cerebras, and WebLLM simultaneously. Each model generates a response. Our ensemble engine then analyzes all responses and selects the most accurate, coherent, and helpful one – giving you the best possible answer.

faqs.question: Is my data private?
faqs.answer: Yes. With WebLLM, inference runs entirely in your browser – no data ever leaves your device. For cloud models, we don’t store your conversations.

faqs.question: How fast is KALKI 6.0?
faqs.answer: Sub‑100ms latency for the first token, and streaming responses feel instant. We use Groq’s lightning‑fast inference and optimize routing.

faqs.question: How do I get started?
faqs.answer: Simply navigate to the KI Bot page and start chatting. For business inquiries, use the contact page or the king hat button on the KI Bot page.

faqs.question: What is WebLLM?
faqs.answer: WebLLM is a library that runs large language models directly in your browser using WebGPU. It’s private, fast, and doesn’t require any cloud APIs.

faqs.question: Can I integrate KALKI AI into my own app?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer a developer API. Contact us via the king hat button for access.

distributed_inference.description: KALKI 6.0 uses a distributed node network where volunteer browsers contribute compute power. This enables near‑zero‑cost inference and massive scalability.
